shop.verifyBody: The ID matches the owner. Payouts can start once the shop has a Bakong ID.
shop.verified: Shop verified. The owner has been told.
shop.rejectBody: The shop leaves the marketplace until the owner sends a new ID photo.
shop.rejected: ID rejected. The owner has been told why.
shop.suspendBody: It disappears from the marketplace and takes no new orders or bookings. Open orders stay as they are.
shop.reinstateBody: It comes back to the marketplace right away.

user.suspendBody: They are signed out on every device at once and can't sign in until reinstated.
user.suspended: Account suspended and signed out everywhere.
user.reinstated: Account reinstated. They can sign in again.
user.signOutBody: Ends {n, plural, =0 {all sessions} one {# active session} other {# active sessions}}. They can sign in again (use this for a lost phone).

orders.title: Orders
orders.stuckHint: Stuck orders: still new 30 minutes after they were placed, or accepted / packed and not sent out within a day. Ask the shop or cancel for the customer.

order.cancelBody: The items go back in stock and both the customer and the shop are told.
order.cancelBodyPaid: {amount} is refunded to the customer, the items go back in stock, and both sides are told.
order.refundBody: {amount} goes back to the customer and the order becomes Returned. Use this to settle a dispute after delivery.
order.restock: Put the items back in stock
order.restockHint: Off if the items can't be sold again

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.hideBody: It leaves the shop's page and item pages, and stops counting in the ratings.

promos.title: Promo codes
promos.sub: VirtualBiz's own codes. Customers type them at checkout in any shop.
promos.endBody: Customers can no longer use it. This can't be undone.
promos.emptySub: Create one for a campaign, e.g. WATERFEST.

f.name: Name
f.endsHint: The code stops working by itself at this time; no need to end it.

err.name: Give it a name (2–60 characters).
err.code: Use 3–20 letters or digits, not already used.
err.endsAt: It must end after it starts.
err.failed: Couldn't save. Check the fields and try again.

payouts.title: Payouts
payouts.sub: VirtualBiz collects online payments and pays shops {days, plural, =0 {the same day as delivery} one {the day after delivery} other {# days after delivery}} (change it in Settings). Returns after that come off the next payout.
payouts.payBody: Transfer {amount} to {bakong} in your banking app, then record the transfer reference here.
payouts.referenceNeeded: Enter the bank transfer reference (3–80 characters).
payouts.paid: Payout to {name} recorded. The shop has been told.
payouts.emptyBalancesSub: Shops appear here once online payments come in.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.sub: Every staff action, newest first. It can't be edited.

settings.title: Settings
settings.sub: How VirtualBiz charges, pays shops and shows prices, the marketplace's categories, and who runs this console.
settings.readOnly: Only a super-admin can change these.
settings.commissionHelp: VirtualBiz's share of each order paid online (KHQR or card). Cash on delivery and manual orders pay no commission. A change applies to orders paid from now on.
settings.commissionExample: On a $100.00 order paid online, VirtualBiz keeps {fee} and the shop gets {shop}.
settings.delayHelp: How long after delivery or pickup an online payment waits before it can be paid out, so returns can still come off it.
settings.delayN: {n, plural, one {# day after delivery} other {# days after delivery}}
settings.rateHelp: Riel per US dollar. Prices are stored in USD; the riel shown next to them, POS cash change and payout totals use this rate, rounded to 100 riel.
settings.catFailed: Couldn't save the category. Try again.
settings.errDup: Another category of this type has this name.
settings.catForProduct: For product shops. Its id is made from the English name and never changes.
settings.catForService: For service providers. Its id is made from the English name and never changes.
settings.catShowHint: Shops can still choose a hidden category; it just isn't in the category bar.

suggest.title: {n, plural, one {# category suggestion} other {# category suggestions}} from shops
suggest.sub: Approve as a new category or one you have, or decline with a reason the shop sees.
suggest.rejectBody: The shop sees your reason in its inbox and settings.
suggest.rejected: Suggestion declined; the shop was told.

security.pwLead: This account was created with a temporary password. Choose your own before opening the console.
security.pwRulesNotMet: The new password doesn't meet the rules below.
security.setupLead: Staff accounts can change money, shops and people, so each sign-in also needs a code from your phone. Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password…).
security.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
security.setupManual: Can't scan? Add this key by hand (time-based, 6 digits):
security.codeWrong: That code isn't right. Check your phone's time and try the newest code.
security.codeWrongLeft: That code isn't right. {n, plural, one {# try left} other {# tries left}} before you're signed out.
security.codesLead: If you lose your phone, each of these codes signs you in once. Keep them somewhere safe, like a password manager. They won't be shown again.
security.verifyLead: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
security.recoveryLead: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each works once.
security.useRecovery: Lost your phone? Use a recovery code

staff.mfaOffOptional: Optional: turn it on to be asked for a code from your phone at each sign-in.
staff.codesLow: Running low: make new recovery codes.
staff.newCodesShown: Save these now; they won't be shown again.
staff.roleBody: It takes effect on their next console request.
staff.removeBody: They lose console access at once. Their customer account stays.
staff.resetBody: For a lost or replaced phone. They're signed out everywhere and set it up again at their next sign-in. Confirm who they are before you do this.
staff.resetDone: {name} will set up two-step sign-in again
staff.inviteLead: They get an email link (valid 7 days) to join with a strong password, then set up two-step sign-in.
staff.name: Name

roleHelp.ADMIN: Support: shops, accounts, orders, reviews, promo codes and payouts.
roleHelp.SUPER_ADMIN: Everything, including platform settings, categories, staff and roles.

staff.errAlready: This person is already on the staff.

staff.devLinkHint: Shown because email isn't set up in this environment. Send it privately: it lets the holder join the staff.
